preconditions.description: The number of digits n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of operations k is between 0 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The length of the digit array d is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(d[i]) <= 9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each digit in the array d is a positive integer between 1 and 9 inclusive.
The first digit of the number does not equal zero.

postconditions.description: The length of the resulting number is equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in ['4', '7'] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each digit in the resulting number is either '4' or '7'.
The resulting number is the final state of the digit array d after performing k operations.
